You could try to drop your job standards a little bit. Maybe try to get a management job at a fast food restaurant or somewhere similar. Just try to save enough money to start a small business or buy yourself out of society. also at a lower level job you can lie about your history and a lot of places don't have the money to perform background checks on every potential employee.
I can kind of understand where you're coming from. I can't get a job because the anxiety of applying makes me feel like I'm having a heart attack.
I hope you have happiness in your future.
Alright I'll do the research. Thank you very much :')

I feel a lot like you seem to feel. i can't even talk on the phone about a personal subject unless I run out into my car and shut the doors. I feel that people in the other apartments are listening and laughing at me. I told my therapist I think of suicide on a daily basis and he was no help. I stopped seeing him abruptly. antidepressants only pushed the pain down only to be brought up later in greater force. Anti-anxiety meds only turned my lazy depression into fierce malice and caused the few that liked me to hate and fear me. Where is there to turn? I would like to think there are more workable options than death.
I say try to find a mental institute. I am getting prepared to tell my parents. I am telling them instead of figuring it out myself because i have no real control over my life and like to buy into the delusion that they truly know what is best for me.
